summary: Enroll verdict compatibility fixtures before fresh-writer archive recovery

replay.detail: No production history replay or rewrite.

schema.detail: No storage format or migration changes.

rules.detail: The judging-prune and verdict-index fixtures migrate their original legacy identities through supported fleet enrollment before settling and archiving. Restores retain fresh writer identities and recover authenticated membership roots from the archive; no node keys or configuration are copied.

compatibility.detail: All verdict equality, pruning, index and recovery assertions remain unchanged. Source inspection supports the trust-root diagnosis; runtime success is not implied.

recovery.detail: Privacy-floor rollback still requires restoring a pre-upgrade backup.
